entries.meaning: The central orienting line of the cosmology; the relation that prevents the system from becoming a pile of disconnected symbols.
The source-side archetype from which the upper architecture is oriented.
The embodied and experiential counterpart who enters the Plane and becomes Door/Vessel/Ladder.
Mirror, recognition and witness; the one who discovers relationship through encounter rather than assumption.
Courage, kingship, protection and purposeful strength in the Son archetype.
The interface between domains; neither side alone, but the passage between them.
A carrier that transports meaning or relationship across a boundary.
A transformed threshold that becomes traversable connection.
Grounded life, nourishment, hidden potential, reproduction and growth from humble matter.
Illumination discovered inside ordinary grounded life.
Material beginning, imperfection and the soil from which growth emerges.
A finite observer inside the Plane who can perceive only part of the larger architecture.
Comic observer archetype: curious, noisy, limited, loyal, capable of learning and prone to misunderstanding.
Creativity, love, emergence, outward movement and expansion.
Memory, precision, conservation, fear-awareness and rootward movement.
Living relational architecture joining roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed.
The failure mode in which connection fragments into extraction, fear, control and conflict.
Memory, foundation, ancestry, hidden support and continuity.
Visible consequence or output of a deeper system.
Compressed future possibility carried forward from one generation/state to another.
The conceptual point beyond ordinary directional description: orientation taken to its symbolic limit.
Still point of observation and responsibility at the upper end of the Axis.
Upper/source dwelling metaphor; in the project's neuro-metaphor, associated with the thalamus.
The experienced field of embodied beings and ordinary causality.
Systems metaphor for accumulated muddiness, incentives, institutions and unresolved dependencies; not a literal secret organization.
A route that continually extracts value, attention or life without regenerative return.
Recursive movement that revisits old states at changed scale or understanding.
Mythic threshold for extreme accumulated duration and persistence.
The ordinary spatial container in the dimensional metaphor.
Reflective/cyclic extension of the Cube symbol.
A metaphorical fusion of higher-dimensional physics vocabulary with the Potato symbol; not an empirical scientific claim.
The mythic transformation of the Son through public digital observation, conflict and symbolic death.
Growth that preserves memory while increasing connection, scale or perspective.
Return into memory, foundation or unresolved material; potentially regenerative or destructive depending on whether it reconnects with life.
A comparative ethical vocabulary used by the project to describe repair, stewardship and making the world more capable of learning; it is not presented as equivalent to Potatoism.
A core ethical instruction of the mythology: understand the thing before demanding that it change.
The practical response to the mythic source: the world is improved through attention, repair and creation by beings inside it.
Stored potential/value metaphor connecting resources, memory, debt and future capacity.
A mythic accounting metaphor used in the user's Potatoverse language. Any numerical claims under this term belong to mythology, not audited finance.
A mythic sovereignty metaphor associated with the Lion/Son and Father architecture; not a statement of real-world political authority.
